opening: Myth or fact? If we only sell to consumers, e-invoicing doesn't apply to us.
source: Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025 (mof.gov.ae), B2C clause; checked 12 Nov 2026
instagram:
Myth or fact? If we only sell to consumers, e-invoicing doesn't apply to us.

Fact, for now. Under Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, business-to-consumer transactions are not subject to the e-invoicing system, and a person dealing only in them is outside it until a later decision (mof.gov.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026).

Consumer-only: outside for now
Any business customer changes that
A later decision can change the scope
